name: fleet-orchestrate
description: claude-fleet orchestration: /fleet-orchestrate opens an orchestrator session (the orchestrator agent file, bound to no issue) — it talks a request through, then hands it to worker sessions; its instructions are its system prompt, so they ride a compaction. Dispatching from anywhere is ⌘P's ⚡ row (issue #3328); an old /qd forwards to it for one version. Not installed by default (EPIC #3111).
